QUOTE: "The text before the first `:` is the tool glob. The text after it is an argument glob." and "`filesystem.*` (no `:`) | the fully-qualified tool name matches the fnmatch glob, whatever the args" and "Matching is plain `fnmatch` with flags 0."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, the split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
